definition_zh: 定性的；性质上的；质的；描述性的；非量化的；品质层面的；（化学）定性分析的
definition_en: relating to qualities or to the kind of thing something is, rather than to how much of it there is
core_image: 不去数篮子里有几个苹果，而是拿起每一个看颜色、尝味道、摸质地——只问「什么样」，不问「多少」
scene: 这里指「定性的」。 A researcher closes the spreadsheet and says: The interviews are qualitative data, so we describe themes instead of counting answers.
sceneCN: 这里 qualitative 是「描述性的、非量化的」（第 4 个义项：用文字描述而不计量）；句意：访谈属于定性数据，所以我们描述主题，而不是统计答案。画面里有录音笔、被高亮的文本和合上的表格。

pos.zh: 定性的；性质（上）的；质的；描述性的

senses.title: Qualitative research: study by description
senses.titleCN: 定性研究：靠描述做学问
senses.definition: using observation, interviews, or written accounts rather than measurement to study something
senses.definitionCN: 用观察、访谈或文字记述来研究，而不是用测量
senses.example: The team ran a qualitative study of how nurses talk to patients.
senses.exampleCN: 团队开展了一项定性研究，考察护士如何与病人交谈。
senses.why: The word was coined in early 15c. as 'that produces a quality'; only around 1600 did it mean 'concerned with quality without reference to quantity'. Research methods took that second sense and made it a name for work that records kinds and meanings instead of numbers.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在 15 世纪初造出时意为「产生某种性质的」；直到约 1600 年才表示「只关性质、不涉数量」。研究方法取了这个义项，用它命名记录种类与意义、而非数字的工作。

senses.title: Of a quality: belonging to what something is
senses.titleCN: 性质上的：属于「它是什么」的那一面
senses.definition: relating to a quality or qualities that something possesses
senses.definitionCN: 关于某物所具有的性质或属性的
senses.example: Heat and cold are qualitative states of the air, not amounts of it.
senses.exampleCN: 冷与热是空气的性质状态，而不是空气的量。
senses.why: Medieval Latin qualitativus meant 'relating to quality', built on qualitas. The adjective simply points at the property itself: not how much, but what sort.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪拉丁语 qualitativus 意为「关于性质的」，由 qualitas 构成。这个形容词只是指向性质本身：不是多少，而是何种。

senses.title: Qualitative difference: a difference in kind
senses.titleCN: 质的差别：种类上的不同
senses.definition: describing a difference in kind, character, or nature rather than in degree or amount
senses.definitionCN: 指种类、性质或本性上的差别，而非程度或数量上的
senses.example: There is a qualitative difference between being tired and being ill.
senses.exampleCN: 「累」和「病」之间有质的差别。
senses.why: Once the adjective means 'concerned with quality alone', two things can differ in quality rather than quantity. This is the sense that lets English oppose qualitative to quantitative as two kinds of difference.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个形容词表示「只关乎性质」，两样东西就可以在性质上而非数量上不同。正是这个义项让英语把 qualitative 与 quantitative 对立成两种差别。

senses.title: Qualitative data: words, not figures
senses.titleCN: 定性数据：是文字，不是数字
senses.definition: consisting of descriptions, words, images, or observations rather than numerical measurements
senses.definitionCN: 由描述、文字、图像或观察构成，而不是数值测量
senses.example: The report mixes qualitative field notes with a few simple counts.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告把定性的田野笔记与少量简单计数混在一起。
senses.why: Data can be sorted by what it is: numbers measure amount, words record kind. The adjective's 'without reference to quantity' sense gives the label for the second pile.
senses.whyCN: 数据可以按「是什么」分类：数字测量数量，文字记录种类。这个形容词「不涉数量」的义项正好为第二堆数据提供了名称。

senses.title: Quality-level: better in kind, not bigger
senses.titleCN: 品质层面：好在质地，而非更大
senses.definition: relating to the standard or excellence of something rather than its size or amount
senses.definitionCN: 关于某物的水准或优良程度，而非大小或数量
senses.example: The reform brought a qualitative improvement in care, not more beds.
senses.exampleCN: 这项改革带来的是护理品质的提升，而不是更多床位。
senses.why: From 'relating to quality' comes the evaluative use: a qualitative gain is a gain in how good something is. English keeps quality for both 'property' and 'excellence', and the adjective follows both.
senses.whyCN: 从「关于性质」引申出评价用法：qualitative 的提升就是「好在哪」的提升。英语的 quality 兼指「属性」与「优良」，这个形容词两条都跟着走。

senses.title: Qualitative analysis: find out what is there
senses.titleCN: 定性分析：先查明「有什么」
senses.definition: in chemistry, identifying the substances present in a sample without measuring how much of each there is
senses.definitionCN: 化学中鉴定样品里存在哪些物质，而不测定各有多少
senses.example: Qualitative analysis showed the powder contained lead.
senses.exampleCN: 定性分析显示这种粉末含铅。
senses.why: Chemistry splits the question in two: what is it, and how much. The first question asks for kind, so it takes the adjective of quality; quantitative takes the question of amount.
senses.whyCN: 化学把问题一分为二：这是什么，有多少。第一个问的是种类，于是用「性质」的形容词；第二个问数量，才用 quantitative。

senses.title: Qualitative change: a leap into another state
senses.definition: in philosophy, a change in the essential nature of something, as opposed to a change only in amount
senses.definitionCN: 哲学上指事物根本本性的变化，与仅数量上的变化相对
senses.example: The textbook describes water turning to steam as a qualitative change.
senses.exampleCN: 这本教材把水变成蒸汽描述为一种质变。
senses.why: Aristotelian philosophy used qualitas for one of its categories; English inherited that seriousness. If a thing changes in kind and not merely in degree, the change is qualitative — a new state, not a larger old one.
senses.whyCN: 亚里士多德哲学把 qualitas 当作范畴之一，英语继承了这份严肃。当事物在种类上而非仅在程度上改变，这变化就是 qualitative 的——是新状态，而不是旧状态的加量。

senses.title: Qualitative judgement: the feel of a thing
senses.titleCN: 定性判断：凭手感下的结论
senses.definition: based on impressions, experience, or observed character rather than on exact measurement
senses.definitionCN: 基于印象、经验或观察到的特性，而非精确测量
senses.example: The chef made a qualitative judgement about the sauce by tasting it.
senses.exampleCN: 厨师尝了一口，对酱汁作出了定性判断。
senses.why: Where numbers are unavailable, judgement still works by noticing qualities: colour, texture, tone. The adjective names that kind of knowing — real but not countable.
senses.whyCN: 没有数字可用时，判断仍可靠察觉性质来运作：颜色、质地、味道。这个形容词命名的就是这种「真实但数不清」的认识方式。

senses.title: A qualitative adjective: naming a quality
senses.titleCN: 性质形容词：直接命名一种性质
senses.definition: in grammar, an adjective that describes a quality of a noun, such as wooden, kind, or heavy
senses.definitionCN: 语法上指描述名词性质的形容词，如 wooden、kind、heavy
senses.example: Wooden is a qualitative adjective, while this in this table is not.
senses.exampleCN: wooden 是性质形容词，而 this table 里的 this 不是。
senses.why: Grammarians needed a word for adjectives that assign a quality rather than point, count, or relate. They borrowed the adjective of quality itself: a qualitative adjective is one that says what kind.
senses.whyCN: 语法学家需要一个词来指「赋予性质」而非指认、计数或关联的形容词，于是借用了「性质」这个形容词本身：qualitative adjective 就是说明「何种」的那类形容词。

intro.en: Qualitative descends from the Latin question qualis, 'of what kind?' Cicero coined qualitas to render Greek poiotēs, and Medieval Latin added the adjective. English first used it for 'producing a quality' and only around 1600 for 'concerned with quality, not quantity'.
intro.cn: qualitative 源自拉丁语的提问词 qualis「何种？」。西塞罗造出 qualitas 来翻译希腊语 poiotēs，中世纪拉丁语又加上形容词形式。英语先用它表「产生某种性质的」，到约 1600 年才表「只关性质、不涉数量」。

items.en: Qualis was the correlative question word 'of what kind? what sort of?'. Its deeper PIE root *kwo-, the stem of relative and interrogative pronouns, is a reconstruction with no written record, so that layer is marked source uncertain.
items.cn: Qualis 是关联疑问词「何种的？哪一类的？」。它更深的印欧语词根 *kwo-（关系代词与疑问代词词干）是重构形式，没有书面记录，因此那一层标为「来源不确定」。

items.en: Qualitas 'a quality, property; nature, state, condition' is said to have been coined by Cicero to translate Greek poiotēs. The word therefore begins as a philosopher's loan-translation, not a folk term.
items.cn: Qualitas「性质、属性；本性、状态、状况」据说由西塞罗造出，用来翻译希腊语 poiotēs。因此这个词一开始就是哲学家的仿译词，而非民间口语。

items.en: Qualitativus 'relating to quality' supplied the adjective. The suffix -ivus marks 'belonging to or having the nature of', the same ending that gives English -ive.
items.cn: Qualitativus「关于性质的」提供了形容词形式。后缀 -ivus 表示「属于……或有……性质的」，正是英语 -ive 的来源。

items.en: English first records qualitative as qualitatif in the early 15c., meaning 'that produces a (physical) quality'. The word described causes, not methods: a quality-producing agent.
items.cn: 英语最早记录为 15 世纪初的 qualitatif，意为「产生（物理）性质的」。这个词当时描述的是原因而非方法：一个产生性质的动因。

items.en: The modern sense 'concerned with quality, relating to the possession of qualities without reference to quantities' appears about 1600, from French qualitatif or Medieval Latin qualitativus. Quantity drops out, and kind stands alone.
items.cn: 现代义「关于性质的、只涉及是否具有性质而不涉数量」约在 1600 年出现，来自法语 qualitatif 或中世纪拉丁语 qualitativus。数量退场，只剩下种类。

items.en: The adjective became the standard partner and opposite of quantitative in research writing. This pairing is a modern intellectual arrangement, not a separate etymology: the same Latin word simply had its 'not quantity' sense put to work.
items.cn: 这个形容词在现代研究写作中成为 quantitative 的标准搭档与对立面。这种配对是近代的思想安排，而非另一套词源：同一个拉丁词只是让它的「非数量」义发挥了作用。

note.en: The first group is chosen for spelling and sound, the second for meaning, so that form and sense stay separate.
note.cn: 第一组按拼写和读音挑选，第二组按词义挑选，这样词形和词义不会混在一起。

entries.definition: relating to quantity or amount. It differs from qualitative by two letters and by the whole question it asks.
entries.definitionCN: 关于数量或数额的。它与 qualitative 只差几个字母，但问的是完全不同的问题。

entries.definition: the property or standard of something. Qualitative is the adjective built on it.
entries.definitionCN: 性质；质量。qualitative 正是由它构成的形容词。

entries.definition: having the necessary training or a stated limitation. It belongs to qualify, not to quality.
entries.definitionCN: 有资格的；有限定的。它属于 qualify，而不是 quality。

entries.definition: a word or person that limits or qualifies. Another branch of the qual- family.
entries.definitionCN: 限定词；取得资格者。qual- 词族的另一支。

entries.definition: giving an account of what something is like rather than measuring it.
entries.definitionCN: 描述某物是什么样子，而非测量它。

entries.definition: resting on personal feeling or judgement rather than external measurement.
entries.definitionCN: 基于个人感受或判断，而非外部测量。

entries.definition: based on broad impressions rather than exact detail or figures.
entries.definitionCN: 基于整体印象，而非精确细节或数据。

entries.definition: concerned with explaining meaning, as qualitative research does with interviews and texts.
entries.definitionCN: 着力解释意义的，正如定性研究处理访谈与文本那样。

normalIntro.en: These links are real: Latin qualis 'of what kind', qualitas 'quality', and the English family quality, qualify, qualitative.
normalIntro.cn: 这些联想都是真实的：拉丁语 qualis「何种」、qualitas「性质」，以及英语词族 quality、qualify、qualitative。

normal.en: qualitative = quality + -ative: it is the adjective of quality, just as quantitative is the adjective of quantity.
normal.cn: qualitative = quality + -ative：它是 quality 的形容词，正如 quantitative 是 quantity 的形容词。

normal.en: Qualis asks 'of what kind?', which is exactly what qualitative research tries to answer.
normal.cn: qualis 问的是「何种？」，这正是定性研究想回答的问题。

normal.en: One letter cluster separates the twins: qual- asks what kind, quant- asks how much.
normal.cn: 一对孪生词只差一簇字母：qual- 问「何种」，quant- 问「多少」。

normal.en: Cicero made qualitas to translate Greek poiotēs, so the word has a philosopher's fingerprint on it.
normal.cn: 西塞罗造 qualitas 来翻译希腊语 poiotēs，所以这个词上留着哲学家的指纹。

normal.en: A qualitative adjective such as wooden tells you what kind, not how many.
normal.cn: 像 wooden 这样的性质形容词告诉你「何种」，而不是「几个」。

abstract.en: The core is a question, not a measurement: what is it like?
abstract.cn: 核心是一个提问，而不是一次测量：它是什么样子的？

abstract.en: Quality describes the inside of a thing; quantity describes its outside size.
abstract.cn: 性质描述一个东西的内部，数量描述它的外部大小。

abstract.en: Everything qualitative can be said in words but not always put on a scale.
abstract.cn: 定性的东西都能用话讲清楚，却不一定能放上秤。

examples.en: The study combines qualitative interviews with a large survey.
examples.cn: 这项研究把定性访谈与大规模问卷调查结合起来。

examples.en: There is a qualitative difference between solving a puzzle and understanding it.
examples.cn: 解出一道谜题与真正理解它之间存在质的差别。

examples.en: Qualitative analysis identified the metal but did not measure its amount.
examples.cn: 定性分析查明了那种金属，但没有测定它的含量。

dict_mnemonic.text: quality（质量）+ -ative（……的）——不问多少，只问「什么质地」→ qualitative 定性的

root: 源自拉丁语 qualis「何种的」，西塞罗据以造出 qualitas「性质」，中世纪拉丁语 qualitativus「关于性质的」经法语进入英语；核心是「问种类、问质地，而不问数量」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses, all variations of one question: what kind is it? The word starts as 'producing a quality', becomes 'about quality rather than quantity', and then serves research methods, chemistry, philosophy, and grammar.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项都是同一个提问的变奏：它属于何种？这个词从「产生性质」开始，变成「关于性质而非数量」，随后服务于研究方法、化学、哲学与语法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: looking at what a thing is like instead of weighing how much of it there is.
core.cn: 核心意象：去看一个东西是什么样子，而不是去称它有多少。

branches.en: METHOD AND DATA: study by description, and words rather than figures.
branches.cn: 方法与数据：以描述做研究，用文字而非数字。

branches.en: PROPERTY AND KIND: what a thing possesses, and differences in kind.
branches.cn: 属性与种类：事物具有的性质，以及种类上的差别。

branches.en: STANDARD AND STATE: improvement in excellence, and change into another state.
branches.cn: 水准与状态：品质上的提升，以及跃入另一种状态的变化。

branches.en: WHAT IS PRESENT: chemical identification without measurement.
branches.cn: 有什么：不作测量的化学鉴定。

branches.en: JUDGEMENT AND GRAMMAR: the feel of a thing, and the adjective that names a quality.
branches.cn: 判断与语法：凭手感下的结论，以及命名性质的形容词。

intro.en: Qualitative is qual- plus -itative. Its family shows the question stem qual- 'what kind', the noun suffix -ity, the verb suffix -ify, and the adjective endings -ed, -ative and -ly.
intro.cn: qualitative 是 qual- 加 -itative。它的词族展示疑问词干 qual-「何种」、名词后缀 -ity、动词后缀 -ify，以及形容词词尾 -ed、-ative 和 -ly。

latinIntro.en: Latin qualis 'of what kind' gives qualitas 'quality', then Medieval Latin qualitativus. The same stem, through qualificare, gives qualify and qualification.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 qualis「何种」给出 qualitas「性质」，再给出中世纪拉丁语 qualitativus。同一个词干经 qualificare 又给出 qualify 与 qualification。

items.meaningCN: 定性的；性质上的（-ative 形容词后缀）
items.example: They chose a qualitative approach for the interviews.
items.exampleCN: 他们对访谈采用了定性方法。

items.structure: Latin qualitas, from qualis (of what kind)
items.meaning: property, character, or degree of excellence
items.example: The quality of the paper is excellent.

items.meaning: to make fit; to limit or modify
items.example: This course qualifies you to teach music.
items.exampleCN: 这门课程使你具备教音乐的资格。

items.meaning: a certificate, condition, or limiting statement
items.meaningCN: 资格；限定条件（-ication 名词后缀）
items.example: She has the qualifications for the post.
items.exampleCN: 她具备担任该职位的资格。

items.meaningCN: 合格的；有资格的（-ed 形容词后缀）

items.meaning: one who qualifies, or a word that limits
items.meaningCN: 取得资格者；限定词（-er 后缀）
items.example: Very is a qualifier in very cold.
items.exampleCN: very 在 very cold 中是限定词。

items.meaning: to make unfit or declare ineligible
items.meaningCN: 取消资格（dis- 否定 + qualify）
items.example: The runner was disqualified for a false start.
items.exampleCN: 那名跑者因抢跑被取消资格。

items.meaningCN: 无资格的；彻底的、无保留的（un- 否定）
items.example: She gave the plan unqualified support.
items.exampleCN: 她毫无保留地支持这项计划。

items.meaning: in terms of quality, not amount
items.meaningCN: 定性地；从性质上（-ly 副词后缀）
items.exampleCN: 这两个系统在性质上不同。

latinEntries.meaning: of what kind? what sort of?

definition_zh: 质量；品质；特性；优质；音质
definition_en: how good or bad something is when judged against others of its kind; a feature that belongs to a person or thing; a high standard of excellence; the character of a sound
core_image: 一块被反复打磨的旧木料，纹理清晰，手感沉实
scene: 调音师把耳机贴紧耳朵，反复听同一段录音，判断那台旧钢琴的声音底色。The quality of the piano's tone surprised the young tuner.
sceneCN: 这里 quality 是「声音的独有底色」（第 5 个义项：声音的特质与音质）；句意为那台钢琴的音色让年轻的调音师吃了一惊。画面里可留意：耳机、谱架、被手摸得发亮的琴键。

pos.zh: 质量；品质；特性；优质；音质

derivatives.zh: quality 换成 -itative，指「定性的、与性质有关的」，与定量相对
qualitative 加 -ly，指「从性质上、定性地说」
同出拉丁词干，指使合格、取得资格，是 quality 的动词同族形式

senses.title: The standard of something
senses.definition: how good or bad a thing is when it is judged against other things of the same kind
senses.definitionCN: 把某物与同类事物相比较时，它好或坏的程度
senses.example: The quality of the sound on that old tape is still remarkable.
senses.exampleCN: 那盘旧磁带的声音质量依然出色。
senses.why: Latin qualitas named the nature of a thing; judging that nature against other natures produced the modern sense of a standard.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 qualitas 本指事物的本性；把这种本性与别的本性相比较，就产生了现代「质量水准」的意思。

senses.title: A feature of a thing or person
senses.definition: a detail or feature that forms part of the nature of a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 构成人或事物本性的一部分的具体细节或特征
senses.example: Hardness is one quality of diamond that makes it so useful.
senses.exampleCN: 坚硬是钻石如此有用的一项特性。
senses.why: If qualitas is the whole nature of a thing, then each part of that nature can be singled out and called a quality.
senses.whyCN: 如果 qualitas 指一物的整体本性，那么把这本性中的每一项单独拎出来，就可以称为一项 quality。

senses.title: A good personal trait
senses.definition: a part of someone's character that is good and worth praising
senses.definitionCN: 一个人性格中值得称赞的良性部分
senses.example: Honesty is the quality I value most in a friend.
senses.exampleCN: 诚实是我在朋友身上最看重的品质。
senses.why: English speakers narrowed the neutral word for nature to the traits people praise, so a quality often means a virtue.
senses.whyCN: 英语使用者把这个中性的「本性」一词收窄到人们称赞的性格特征，于是 a quality 常常就是一项美德。

senses.title: A high standard of excellence
senses.definition: a level of excellence clearly above the ordinary, often used before a noun
senses.definitionCN: 明显高于普通水准的优良程度，常放在名词前作定语
senses.example: This shop sells quality furniture at fair prices.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店以公道的价格出售优质家具。
senses.why: Once the word meant standard in general, shops could use it as a badge: goods of quality are goods of high standard.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既然泛指「水准」，商家就能把它当成品级标记来用：goods of quality 就是高水准的货物。

senses.title: The character of a sound
senses.definition: the particular character of a voice or an instrument as heard by the ear
senses.definitionCN: 人声或乐器被耳朵听到时所具有的独特性质
senses.example: The piano has a warm quality that fills the room.
senses.exampleCN: 这架钢琴有一种温暖、能充满房间的音色。
senses.why: The sense of nature extends to what the ear perceives, so the nature of a sound is also called its quality.
senses.whyCN: 「本性」这一层意思可以延伸到耳朵所感知的东西，所以一种声音的本性也被称作它的 quality。

intro.en: Quality goes back to the Latin question word for of what kind and to the noun coined from it; French carried the word to English, where it split into standard, feature and excellence.
intro.cn: quality 源自拉丁语中表示「何种」的疑问词以及由它造出的名词；法语把这个词带入英语，随后它分化为「水准、特征、优质」几层意思。

items.en: Qualis was the question word for of what kind, and it stood at the head of a family of words about the nature of things.
items.cn: qualis 是表示「何种」的疑问词，它站在一整族谈论事物本性的词的最前面。

items.en: Qualitas was coined to name the answer to that question: the whatness of a thing, its nature taken as a whole.
items.cn: qualitas 是为回答那个问题而造的名词：一物的「什么性」，把它的本性当作整体来看。

items.en: Old French took the noun as qualite and used it for the character or rank of a person or thing.
items.cn: 古法语把这个名词接受为 qualite，用来指人或事物的性质或等级。

items.en: Middle English used qualite for nature and rank, and later spelling was reshaped toward the Latin form as quality.
items.cn: 中古英语用 qualite 表示本性与等级，后来的拼写又被改造成接近拉丁语的 quality。

items.en: Modern English keeps the neutral sense of standard and adds the senses of a single feature, of personal virtue and of high grade.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了中性的「水准」义，又增加了单项特征、个人品德与高档品级这几层意思。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same Latin stem of kind; the near-meaning group gathers nouns for features, traits and grades.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁词干（何种）上的词；近义组收表示特征、品性与等级的名词。

entries.definition: A certificate or skill showing that a person meets a standard.
entries.definitionCN: 证明某人达到某项标准的证书或技能。

entries.definition: Based on qualities rather than on measured amounts.
entries.definitionCN: 依据性质而非测得数量的。

entries.definition: A match that decides who advances, or a word that limits another.
entries.definitionCN: 决定谁晋级的比赛，或限定另一词的词。

entries.definition: To meet a standard or to gain a right.
entries.definitionCN: 达到标准或取得某项权利。

entries.definition: A feature that belongs to a thing and affects how it behaves.
entries.definitionCN: 属于某物并影响其表现的特征。

entries.definition: A quality that is regarded as part of a person or thing.
entries.definitionCN: 被视为人或事物一部分的性质。

entries.definition: A feature that makes a person or thing easy to recognize.
entries.definitionCN: 使人或事物容易被辨认出来的特征。

entries.definition: A level of quality given to goods or work.
entries.definitionCN: 给货物或工作评定的质量等级。

normalIntro.en: The word answers the old question of what kind a thing is; from that answer English drew the ideas of standard, trait and high grade.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词回答的是古老的问题：一物属于哪一种；英语从这个答案里引出了水准、特征与高档这几层意思。

normal.en: Quality and qualify share the Latin question of what kind: to qualify is to prove which kind you are, and quality is the kind itself.
normal.cn: quality 与 qualify 共用拉丁语「何种」这一问：使合格就是证明你属于哪一类，而 quality 就是那个类别本身。

normal.en: The plural qualities is the usual word for the separate traits of one person's character.
normal.cn: 复数 qualities 常用来指一个人性格中一项项分开的特征。

normal.en: Qualitative work asks what kind something is, while quantitative work asks how much of it there is.
normal.cn: 定性工作问的是某物属于哪一类，定量工作问的则是它的量有多少。

normal.en: In shops, quality before a noun is a short badge for high grade, as in quality paper or quality service.
normal.cn: 在商店里，quality 放在名词前就是「高档」的简写标记，如优质纸张、优质服务。

normal.en: The quality of a sound is what the ear notices apart from its loudness: warm, sharp, flat or full.
normal.cn: 声音的 quality 是耳朵在音量之外察觉到的特点：温暖、尖利、平淡或饱满。

abstract.en: A quality is a judgment that never exists alone: it always compares one thing with another of its kind.
abstract.cn: 质量是一种从不单独存在的判断：它总要把一物与同类中的另一物相比。

abstract.en: The same word names what a thing is and how good it is, because in English the nature of a thing and its worth are hard to separate.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既指某物是什么，又指它有多好，因为在英语里，一物的本性与它的价值很难分开。

abstract.en: To praise someone's qualities is to treat character as a set of parts that can be counted.
abstract.cn: 称赞某人的品质，就是把性格当作一组可以逐项清点的部分。

examples.en: The quality of the recording is poor, but the music is still worth hearing.
examples.cn: 录音质量很差，但这音乐仍然值得一听。

examples.en: Patience is a quality that grows only through practice.
examples.cn: 耐心是一种只能通过练习才能生长的品质。

examples.en: The hotel is known for quality service rather than for low prices.
examples.cn: 这家旅馆出名靠的是优质服务，而不是低价。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「夸了提」——东西好到大家夸了又提，说明质量过硬，记住 quality 是质量、品质。

root: 拉丁语 qualis（何种的）→ qualitas（本性、性质）→ 古法语 qualite → 英语 quality；同族有 qualify、qualification、qualitative。

sensesIntro.en: The core is the nature of a thing; the senses run from the whole nature to a single feature, then to a praised trait, to high grade and to the character of a sound.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是一物的本性；义项从整体本性走向单项特征，再走向受称赞的品德、高档品级，最后走向声音的特质。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old plank rubbed smooth, its grain clear and its weight solid in the hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块被反复打磨的旧木板，纹理清晰，握在手里沉实。

branches.en: a ruler laid against two planks
branches.cn: 一把放在两块木板旁比较的尺

branches.en: one clear line of grain in the wood
branches.cn: 木料上一条清晰的纹理

branches.en: a friend who keeps a promise
branches.cn: 一个守信的朋友

branches.en: a shop window marked with a grade
branches.cn: 橱窗上标着品级的标签

branches.en: a warm note held in the ear
branches.cn: 一段留在耳边的温暖音符

intro.en: The word is held together by the Latin question word for kind, the suffix that turns it into a noun, and the English endings that build related adjectives and verbs.
intro.cn: 这个词由拉丁语中询问种类的疑问词、把它变成名词的后缀，以及构成相关形容词与动词的英语词缀共同支撑。

latinIntro.en: Latin left a short but clear family around the question word for kind.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语围绕「何种」这个疑问词留下了一个短而清楚的同族词群。

definition_zh: 数量的；定量的；可量化的；以数字表示的；按量计的；（经济）数量型的
definition_en: relating to amount or number, especially when data are measured and expressed as figures
core_image: 一架天平把两堆东西换成两排数字
scene: 这里指「数量的」。 The paper combined quantitative data from weather stations with interviews from farmers.
sceneCN: 这里 quantitative 是「定量的」（第 2 个义项：可计数、可统计的数值资料）；句意：这篇论文把气象站的定量数据与农民的访谈结合起来。图中可辨识物件：一排排读数、温度曲线、访谈记录本。

pos.zh: 数量的；定量的；可量化的

senses.title: About amount
senses.definition: concerned with amount, size or number rather than kind
senses.definitionCN: 关心数量、规模或数目，而非种类
senses.example: The report offers a quantitative picture of how many households lack clean water.
senses.exampleCN: 报告用数量呈现了有多少家庭缺乏清洁用水。
senses.why: Quantus asked 'how much'. Quantitative marks whatever deals with that question instead of the question 'what kind'.
senses.whyCN: quantus 问的是“多少”。quantitative 标记处理这个问题的东西，而不是处理“何种”问题的东西。

senses.title: Measured and counted
senses.definition: based on measurement, counting and numerical records
senses.definitionCN: 以测量、计数与数值记录为基础
senses.example: Quantitative evidence showed a steady fall in soil moisture.
senses.exampleCN: 定量证据显示土壤含水量持续下降。
senses.why: Data become quantitative when they can be counted or measured, so that another researcher could repeat the count and get the same figure.
senses.whyCN: 数据在可被计数或测量时才算定量，因为另一位研究者可以重复计数并得到同一数字。

senses.title: Expressible as a number
senses.definition: able to be stated as a figure, rate or percentage
senses.definitionCN: 可以表述为数字、比率或百分比的
senses.example: Speed is quantitative because it can be given a number and a unit.
senses.exampleCN: 速度是定量的，因为它可以用一个数字加单位给出。
senses.why: The property itself is not a number, but it accepts one: give it a unit and a scale and it can be written as a figure.
senses.whyCN: 这种属性本身不是一个数字，但它接受数字：给它一个单位与一把尺，它就能写成一个数值。

senses.title: The style of a study
senses.definition: of research: using statistical samples and numerical analysis rather than interviews or interpretation
senses.definitionCN: 指研究使用统计样本与数值分析，而非访谈或解释
senses.example: The team ran a quantitative study of sleep and exam performance.
senses.exampleCN: 团队开展了一项关于睡眠与考试成绩的定量研究。
senses.why: A quantitative study is one whose design turns behaviour into variables. Interviews may accompany it, but the spine is the number.
senses.whyCN: 定量研究是设计把行为变成变量的研究。访谈可以并存，但骨架是数字。

senses.title: Amount-based policy
senses.definition: of economic policy: working by expanding the amount of money or credit rather than by setting interest rates
senses.definitionCN: 指经济政策通过扩大货币或信贷数量、而非设定利率来运作
senses.example: The central bank turned to quantitative easing when rates were already near zero.
senses.exampleCN: 利率已接近零时，央行转向量化宽松。
senses.why: Economics uses the adjective for policy that changes quantities directly: the lever is the amount of money created, not its price.
senses.whyCN: 经济学用这个形容词指直接改变数量的政策：杠杆是创造出来的货币量，而不是货币的价格。

senses.title: Written as figures
senses.definition: presented in numerical form, as tables, charts or scores
senses.definitionCN: 以表格、图表或分数等数字形式呈现
senses.example: The results section is largely quantitative, with four tables and two graphs.
senses.exampleCN: 结果部分主要是数字呈现，有四张表与两幅图。
senses.why: Presentation is the visible half of the word: even before anyone counts, the material has been arranged as figures so that patterns can be read at a glance.
senses.whyCN: 呈现是这个词可见的一半：甚至在计数之前，材料已被排成数字，让模式一眼可读。

senses.title: On the more-or-less axis
senses.definition: judged by more or less rather than better or worse
senses.definitionCN: 按多与少判断，而不是按好与坏
senses.example: There was a quantitative gain in sales but no qualitative change in the product.
senses.exampleCN: 销售有数量上的增长，但产品没有性质上的改变。
senses.why: The word names the axis itself. A quantitative gain can be counted, even when nothing about the thing has become better in kind.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的是轴本身。数量上的增长可以被计数，即使事物在性质上并未变好。

senses.title: The numerical side of science
senses.definition: belonging to the branch of a science that deals with measurable magnitudes and their relations
senses.definitionCN: 属于科学中处理可测大小及其关系的部分
senses.example: Quantitative chemistry asks how much of each substance reacts.
senses.exampleCN: 定量化学研究每种物质反应多少。
senses.why: Every science splits into a qualitative and a quantitative side. The quantitative side asks for magnitudes and laws that connect them.
senses.whyCN: 每门科学都分为定性与定量两面。定量的一面追问大小以及连接大小的规律。

intro.en: Quantitative is Medieval Latin quantitativus, from quantitas 'quantity', from quantus 'how much'. It was coined as the partner of qualitativus, the adjective for quality, and entered English through French in the 16th century.
intro.cn: quantitative 来自中古拉丁 quantitativus，出自 quantitas“数量”，再出自 quantus“多少”。它是作为 qualitativus（性质的形容词）的配对词被造出的，16 世纪经法语进入英语。

items.en: Quantus asked 'how much, how many'. It belongs to the same interrogative family as qualis 'of what kind', and the pair still shapes scientific vocabulary.
items.cn: quantus 问“多少”。它与 qualis“何种”同属疑问词族，这对搭配至今塑造着科学词汇。

items.en: Quantitas named amount as a thing in itself. Roman writers used it for size, magnitude and number.
items.cn: quantitas 把数量当作一种事物来命名。罗马作者用它指大小、量值与数目。

items.en: Schoolmen built quantitativus for what belongs to quantity. The category was standard in philosophy before any modern science used it.
items.cn: 经院学者造出 quantitativus 指属于数量的东西。在现代科学使用它之前，这个范畴在哲学中已是标准。

items.en: French passed the adjective to English as quantitative, first in philosophy and mathematics.
items.cn: 法语把形容词 quantitatif 传给英语作 quantitative，最初用于哲学与数学。

items.en: Chemistry, physics and economics made quantitative the mark of reliable work: if it could be counted, it could be trusted.
items.cn: 化学、物理与经济学使 quantitative 成为可靠工作的标记：能计数就可信。

items.en: Quantitative easing named a monetary policy of the 2000s, while survey research made quantitative methods a standard phrase.
items.cn: 量化宽松命名了 2000 年代的货币政策，调查研究中“定量方法”也成为标准说法。

note.en: The look-alike group separates the adjective from its noun, verb and the different-root qualitative. The meaning group contrasts numerical, measurable and statistical description.
note.cn: 形近组区分形容词与名词、动词，以及词根不同的 qualitative；词义组比较数值、可测与统计三类描述。

entries.definition: an amount or number. It is the noun that the adjective describes.
entries.definitionCN: 数量或数目。它是这个形容词所描述的名词。

entries.definition: to express something as a quantity. It is the action of making data quantitative.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物表示为数量。它就是把数据变成定量的动作。

entries.definition: in terms of amount. It tells how a comparison or measurement is made.
entries.definitionCN: 在数量上。它说明比较或测量如何进行。

entries.definition: relating to quality. It looks parallel but comes from qualis 'of what kind', not quantus 'how much'.
entries.definitionCN: 与性质相关的。它看起来结构平行，却来自 qualis“何种”，而非 quantus“多少”。

entries.definition: given in numbers. It says the form is numeric, while quantitative also implies measurement and amount.
entries.definitionCN: 以数字给出的。它说形式是数字的，而 quantitative 还隐含测量与数量。

entries.definition: able to be measured. It describes a property, while quantitative describes an approach or a body of data.
entries.definitionCN: 可测量的。它描述一种属性，而 quantitative 描述一种做法或一批数据。

entries.definition: based on statistics. It adds sampling and probability to the plain idea of counting.
entries.definitionCN: 基于统计的。它在单纯计数之上加上了抽样与概率。

entries.definition: relating to measurement, especially in a system of units. It is narrower than quantitative.
entries.definitionCN: 与测量相关的，尤指单位制。它比 quantitative 更窄。

normalIntro.en: These hooks put the word on the how-much axis, then let it cover data, studies, policies, tables and the numerical side of every science.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩把词放到“多少”这条轴上，再让它覆盖数据、研究、政策、表格与每门科学的数值一面。

normal.en: Split it as quant + itative: how much + adjective. It labels anything that answers with a number.
normal.cn: 拆成 quant + itative：多少、形容词。它标记任何用数字回答问题的事物。

normal.en: Picture a balance that converts two piles into two rows of figures.
normal.cn: 想象一架天平把两堆东西换算成两排数字。

normal.en: If the report counts households, it is quantitative; if it describes their lives, it is qualitative.
normal.cn: 如果报告统计户数，它是定量的；如果描述他们的生活，它是定性的。

normal.en: Quantitative easing changes the amount of money, not the price of borrowing.
normal.cn: 量化宽松改变货币的数量，而不是借贷的价格。

normal.en: A quantitative gain is more of the same, not a better kind of thing.
normal.cn: 数量上的增长是同类东西更多，而不是变成更好的种类。

abstract.en: Keep the quantus/qualis pair: one question asks how much, the other asks of what kind.
abstract.cn: 记住 quantus 与 qualis 的配对：一个问题问多少，另一个问何种。

abstract.en: Notice that the word describes both the data and the attitude: count it, then trust it.
abstract.cn: 注意这个词既描述数据，也描述态度：先计数，再相信。

abstract.en: Whenever you meet it, look for the unit: quantitative talk always carries a hidden 'of what'.
abstract.cn: 每次遇到它，都去找单位：定量话语总藏着一个“什么的多少”。

examples.en: The two reviews reached the same conclusion using different quantitative methods.
examples.cn: 这两篇综述用不同的定量方法得出了相同结论。

examples.en: Researchers reported a quantitative difference of about twelve percent.
examples.cn: 研究者报告了约百分之十二的数量差异。

examples.en: The bank's quantitative easing programme ran for three years.
examples.cn: 该银行的量化宽松计划持续了三年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音“宽提特提夫”：把宽窄高低都提出来，一条条变成数字。

root: 拉丁 quantus“多少”派生 quantitas“数量”，中古拉丁 quantitativus 作形容词；核心是“能数、能量、用数字回答”。

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses all sit on the axis of amount: how many households, how much moisture, what speed, what study design, what money supply, what table, what gain, what magnitude. Qualitative asks what kind; quantitative asks how much.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都坐在“数量”这条轴上：多少户、多少水分、什么速度、什么研究设计、多少货币供给、哪张表、多少增长、多大数值。定性问“何种”，定量问“多少”。

core.en: Data are counted or measured and then written as figures that other people can compare.
core.cn: 数据被计数或测量，然后写成别人可以比较的数字。

branches.en: AXIS AND FORM: the subject is amount, and the form is numerical.
branches.cn: 轴与形式：主题是数量，形式是数字。

branches.en: DATA: counting and measurement make a value that can be repeated.
branches.cn: 数据：计数与测量造出可重复的数值。

branches.en: STUDY: a design turns behaviour into variables and gains into amounts.
branches.cn: 研究：设计把行为变成变量，把增益变成数量。

branches.en: POLICY: the lever is the quantity of money itself.
branches.cn: 政策：杠杆就是货币的数量本身。

branches.en: SCIENCE: the numerical branch asks for magnitudes and laws.
branches.cn: 科学：数值分支追问大小与规律。

intro.en: Quantitative is quantus plus quantitas plus the adjective suffix -ive. The items below follow the how-much stem and set it beside the how-kind stem.
intro.cn: quantitative 由 quantus、quantitas 与形容词后缀 -ive 构成。下列条目沿着“多少”词干，并与“何种”词干对照。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries give the question word and the noun. They show why quantity, quantify and quantitative all answer the same question.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语条目给出疑问词与名词，说明为什么 quantity、quantify 与 quantitative 都在回答同一个问题。

items.example: A small quantity of mercury remained.
Scientists tried to quantify the damage.

items.exampleCN: 这些地点作了定量比较。
量化使这些主张可被检验。

items.meaning: a specialist who measures building costs
items.example: The quantity surveyor priced the steelwork.
items.exampleCN: 工料测量师为钢结构估价。

items.meaning: a fixed amount; a discrete unit
items.example: Energy arrives in quanta, not in a smooth flow.
items.exampleCN: 能量以量子形式到来，而非平滑流动。

definition_zh: 数量；量；大量；数学量；（语音）音长
definition_en: an amount that can be counted or measured; a large amount of something; a measurable property studied in mathematics and physics; the length of a sound in speech
core_image: 一排贴着编号的粮袋，袋口露出不同的刻度线
scene: 仓库管理员拿着清单，一袋一袋核对面粉的重量和袋数，记下每一行的差额。A large quantity of flour was stored in the warehouse that winter.
sceneCN: 这里 quantity 是「大量」（第 2 个义项：不指具体数目，只强调量大）；句意为那个冬天仓库里存了大量面粉。画面里可留意：清单、粮袋、墙上的刻度。

pos.zh: 数量；量；大量；数学量；音长

collocations.zh: 未知量；难以预料的人或事

derivatives.zh: quantity 换后缀成动词，指用数字确定数量
quantity 加 -itative，指「定量的、与数量有关的」
quantify 加 -er，指表示数量的词，如 many、some

senses.title: An amount that can be counted or measured
senses.definition: the amount of something, especially when it can be counted or measured
senses.definitionCN: 某物的量，尤其是可以被清点或计量的部分
senses.example: The quantity of water in the tank fell overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 水箱里的水量一夜之间减少了。
senses.why: Latin quantitas answered the question how much, so the noun first names any measurable amount.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 quantitas 回答的是「多少」这个问题，因此这个名词首先指任何可计量的量。

senses.title: A large amount
senses.definition: a great amount of something, used without a number
senses.definitionCN: 某物很大的量，不与具体数字连用
senses.example: They bought paper in quantity to save money.
senses.exampleCN: 他们大量买纸以省钱。
senses.why: Once the noun meant amount in general, the bare word could stand for a big amount, especially in the phrase in quantity.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词既泛指「量」，光秃秃的单词就能表示「大量」，尤其在 in quantity 这一说法里。

senses.title: A measurable property in mathematics
senses.definition: a property such as mass, length or force that can be measured and expressed by a number
senses.definitionCN: 质量、长度或力这类可以被测量并用数字表示的性质
senses.example: Force is a vector quantity, while mass is a scalar quantity.
senses.exampleCN: 力是矢量量，而质量是标量量。
senses.why: Science needed a neutral noun for anything measurable, and borrowed the everyday word for amount.
senses.whyCN: 科学需要一个中性的名词来指任何可测量之物，于是借用了日常表示「量」的词。

senses.title: The length of a speech sound
senses.definition: the relative length of a vowel or syllable, which can carry meaning in some languages
senses.definitionCN: 元音或音节的相对长短，在某些语言中可以区别意义
senses.example: Latin poetry depends on the quantity of each syllable, not on stress.
senses.exampleCN: 拉丁语诗歌依靠每个音节的长短，而不是依靠重音。
senses.why: In phonetics the amount of time a sound lasts is simply its quantity, the same notion of amount applied to time.
senses.whyCN: 在语音学里，一个声音持续的时间长短就是它的 quantity，仍是「量」这一概念被用在时间上。

intro.en: Quantity comes from the Latin question word for how much and the noun built on it, passed through French into English.
intro.cn: quantity 源自拉丁语表示「多少」的疑问词及由它构成的名词，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Quantus was the question word for how much or how great, the partner of qualis for of what kind.
items.cn: quantus 是表示「多少、多大」的疑问词，与表示「何种」的 qualis 是一对搭档。

items.en: Quantitas was coined as the noun for the answer, naming size or amount as opposed to kind.
items.cn: quantitas 是为回答而造的名词，指大小或多少，与「种类」相对。

items.en: Old French quantite kept the sense of amount and also served for the length of a sound in grammar.
items.cn: 古法语 quantite 保留了「量」的意思，在语法中也用来指音的长短。

items.en: Middle English borrowed the French form and later remade the spelling after the Latin noun.
items.cn: 中古英语借入法语形式，后来又照着拉丁名词改写了拼写。

items.en: Modern English uses the word for plain amounts, for large amounts, for measurable properties and for sound length.
items.cn: 现代英语用这个词指普通数量、大量、可测的量以及语音的长短。

note.en: The look-alike group collects forms on the Latin stem of how much; the near-meaning group collects nouns of amount, number and size.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁语「多少」词干上的形式；近义组收表示数量、数目与规模的名词。

entries.definition: To express something as a number or an amount.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物用数字或数量表示出来。

entries.definition: Measured by amount rather than by kind.
entries.definitionCN: 按数量而非按性质衡量的。

entries.definition: A word such as many or some that shows amount.
entries.definitionCN: 表示数量的词，如 many 或 some。

entries.definition: A fixed smallest unit of energy in physics.
entries.definitionCN: 物理学中一份固定的最小能量单位。

entries.definition: How much there is of something.
entries.definitionCN: 某物有多少。

entries.definition: A count of separate things.
entries.definitionCN: 对可分离事物的计数。

entries.definition: The amount of space something fills.
entries.definitionCN: 某物占据的空间大小。

entries.definition: A total reached by adding amounts.
entries.definitionCN: 把数量相加得到的总数。

normalIntro.en: The word answers how much, in contrast with quality, which answers what kind; the pair has been a matched set since Latin.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词回答「多少」，与回答「何种」的 quality 相对；这对词从拉丁语起就是一套。

normal.en: Quantity and quality are a matched pair: one asks how much, the other asks what kind.
normal.cn: quantity 与 quality 是一对搭档：一个问多少，一个问何种。

normal.en: Quantify means to turn something into a quantity, to give it a number.
normal.cn: quantify 意为把某物变成数量，也就是给它一个数字。

normal.en: Buying in quantity means buying a large amount at one time, which usually lowers the price.
normal.cn: in quantity 指一次买很大的量，通常能压低价格。

normal.en: In physics a vector quantity has direction, while a scalar quantity has only size.
normal.cn: 物理中矢量量有方向，而标量量只有大小。

normal.en: In Latin verse, quantity tells you how long each syllable lasts, and that decides the rhythm.
normal.cn: 在拉丁诗里，音长告诉你每个音节持续多久，由此决定节奏。

abstract.en: Every number hides a decision about what counts as one unit, so quantity is never purely natural.
abstract.cn: 每个数字都藏着「什么算作一个单位」的决定，所以数量从来不纯是自然的。

abstract.en: A large quantity can feel like abundance and also like a burden, depending on who must carry it.
abstract.cn: 大量的东西既能像富足，也能像负担，取决于由谁来扛。

abstract.en: Quantity promises fairness by counting, yet counting always leaves out what cannot be counted.
abstract.cn: 数量靠清点来许诺公平，可清点总会漏掉无法清点的东西。

examples.en: The recipe needs only a small quantity of salt.
examples.cn: 这道菜只需要少量的盐。

examples.en: Books of this kind are cheaper when bought in quantity.
examples.cn: 这类书批量购买时更便宜。

examples.en: Speed is a scalar quantity, but velocity is a vector quantity.
examples.cn: 速率是标量量，而速度是矢量量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「框特体」——用框子一框，量出这一堆东西的体量，记住 quantity 是数量、量。

root: 拉丁语 quantus（多少）→ quantitas（数量）→ 古法语 quantite → 英语 quantity；同族有 quantify、quantitative、quantum。

sensesIntro.en: The core is how much there is; the senses move from any amount to a large amount, then to a measured property in science and to the length of a sound.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「有多少」；义项从任何数量走向大量，再走向科学中可测的量与语音的长短。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rows of numbered grain sacks, each cut open at a different mark on a measuring stick.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排贴着编号的粮袋，每袋都在量尺的不同刻度处被割开。

branches.en: a tank marked with a water line
branches.cn: 水箱上标着的一道水线

branches.en: a cart loaded until the boards bend
branches.cn: 装到木板发弯的一车货物

branches.en: an arrow with length and direction
branches.cn: 一支有长度也有方向的箭头

branches.en: a syllable held longer than its neighbour
branches.cn: 比相邻音节拖得更长的一个音节

branches.en: the same act of measuring, once in a kitchen and once in a lab
branches.cn: 同一个测量动作，一次在厨房，一次在实验室

intro.en: The word rests on the Latin question of how much and the noun suffix that turns an answer into a thing that can be handled.
intro.cn: 这个词立足于拉丁语「多少」这一问，以及把答案变成可把握之物的名词后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin left a small family around quantus, the partner of qualis.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语围绕 quantus 留下了一个小词群，它与 qualis 互为搭档。

definition_zh: 量子；能量或物质的最小不连续单位；定量；份额
definition_en: the smallest discrete amount of a physical quantity, or a fixed share of something
core_image: 水管里流出的水看起来连续，换成极小的量杯量，却总是一格一格地落下
scene: 炉壁烧到发红时，放出的能量并非连续不断。Planck found that energy leaves a hot body in one quantum at a time.
sceneCN: 这里 quantum 指「能量不可再分的最小一份」（第 1 个义项：某个物理量的最小不连续单位）；句意：普朗克发现能量从炽热物体离开时，一次只放出一个量子。图中可辨识物件：炉壁、分格的能量块、温度计、记录纸。

pos.zh: 量子；定量（可数，复数形式为拉丁式）
量子的（作定语，如量子力学）

derivatives.zh: 使量子化；按离散单位处理

senses.title: The smallest discrete packet of energy
senses.titleCN: 能量不可再分的最小一份
senses.definition: the least amount of energy that can be emitted, absorbed or exchanged in a single event
senses.definitionCN: 在一次事件中被放出、吸收或交换的最小能量
senses.example: A photon carries one quantum of light energy.
senses.exampleCN: 一个光子携带一份光能量子。
senses.why: Latin quantum means 'how much', and physics narrowed that question to the smallest amount that can be counted at all.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语本义是「多少」，物理学把这个问法收窄成「能被计数的最小一份」。

senses.title: One packet of light
senses.definition: a single unit of electromagnetic energy, later called a photon
senses.definitionCN: 电磁能量的单一单位，后来称为光子
senses.example: Einstein treated each light quantum as a separate particle.
senses.exampleCN: 爱因斯坦把每一份光量子当作独立的粒子。
senses.why: Light was the first quantity found to come in packets, so the general unit became the everyday name for a light packet.
senses.whyCN: 光是最早被发现按份出现的量，于是这个通用单位成了光的一份的日常称呼。

senses.title: The plural units counted in theory
senses.titleCN: 理论中计数的复数单位
senses.definition: the countable units into which a physical quantity is divided, used in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 某个物理量被分成的可数单位，通常用复数
senses.example: The theory adds up the contributions of many quanta.
senses.exampleCN: 这套理论把许多量子的贡献累加起来。
senses.why: Once a thing arrives in packets, calculations count packets, so the plural became the working noun of the theory.
senses.whyCN: 一旦某物按份到来，计算就要清点份数，于是复数成了理论的常用名词。

senses.title: The adjective of the quantum world
senses.definition: used before another noun to mark a field, state or rule that belongs to quantum theory
senses.definitionCN: 放在另一名词前，标出属于量子理论的领域、状态或规则
senses.example: Quantum theory replaced the smooth classical picture.
senses.exampleCN: 量子理论取代了平滑的经典图景。
senses.why: English routinely turns a key noun into a modifier, so quantum now labels whole fields without changing its form.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把关键名词直接当定语，因此这个词不改词形就能标记整个领域。

senses.title: An abrupt jump between atomic states
senses.titleCN: 原子状态之间的突然跳变
senses.definition: the discontinuous change of an electron from one energy level to another
senses.definitionCN: 电子从一个能级到另一个能级的不连续变化
senses.example: The electron makes a quantum jump and emits a single photon.
senses.exampleCN: 电子发生一次量子跃迁，并放出一个光子。
senses.why: Because energy levels are discrete, a change between them cannot be gradual; it is a jump of one quantum.
senses.whyCN: 能级是分立的，因此能级之间的变化不可能渐变，只能是一份量子的跳跃。

senses.title: A sudden large advance in ordinary life
senses.titleCN: 日常语境里的突然大跨越
senses.definition: a dramatic and abrupt improvement or change, usually in the phrase quantum leap
senses.definitionCN: 戏剧性且突然的改进或变化，通常用于「量子跃迁」这一短语
senses.example: The new vaccine was a quantum leap in prevention.
senses.exampleCN: 新疫苗在预防上是巨大的一步。
senses.why: The metaphor borrows the smallest possible jump in physics and reverses its scale, turning it into the biggest step imaginable.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻借用了物理上最小的一跳，却把尺度反过来，变成想象中最大的一步。

senses.title: The adjective of quantum computing
senses.definition: used of information technology that exploits superposition or entanglement, as in quantum computing
senses.definitionCN: 用于利用叠加或纠缠的信息技术，如量子计算
senses.example: The laboratory built a quantum processor with a hundred units.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室造出一台拥有一百个单元的量子处理器。
senses.why: The same modifier extends to any technology built on discrete quantum states, so computing joined the family.
senses.whyCN: 同一个定语扩展到任何建立在分立量子态上的技术，于是计算也加入了这个家族。

senses.title: A required share or amount
senses.definition: a fixed amount of something required or allotted, as in a quantum of evidence
senses.definitionCN: 所需或被分配的固定分量，如「一份证据」
senses.example: The claim needs a quantum of proof before it can be heard.
senses.exampleCN: 这个说法在获准陈述之前需要一定分量的证据。
senses.why: The legal and formal sense keeps the original 'how much': a case needs a measurable minimum, not a vague impression.
senses.whyCN: 法律与正式用法保留了原本的「多少」：一个案子需要可量的最低分量，而不是模糊印象。

intro.en: Quantum is a Latin neuter form meaning 'how much', adopted by physics in 1900 for the smallest indivisible amount of energy. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: quantum 是拉丁语中性形式，意为「多少」；物理学在 1900 年用它指能量不可再分的最小一份。年代均为约数。

items.en: Quantus was the interrogative and relative adjective 'how great, how much', parallel to tantus 'so great' and qualis 'of what kind'.
items.cn: quantus 是疑问与关系形容词「多大、多少」，与「这么大」和「何种」两个词平行。

items.en: The neuter singular quantum meant 'how much', and in legal and philosophical writing it named a fixed quantity or share.
items.cn: 中性单数 quantum 意为「多少」，在法律与哲学写作中指固定的量或份额。

items.en: Planck proposed that energy is exchanged in fixed packets, and he called each packet an energy quantum, keeping the Latin question word.
items.cn: 普朗克提出能量按固定小包交换，并把每一包称为能量子，沿用了这个拉丁疑问词。

items.en: Einstein extended the idea to light, speaking of light quanta; the name photon came later, but the quantum stayed.
items.cn: 爱因斯坦把这一想法扩展到光，说到光量子；光子的名字出现得更晚，量子却留了下来。

items.en: The phrase for an electron's discontinuous change passed into general speech in the twentieth century as a figure for any sudden advance.
items.cn: 描述电子不连续变化的短语在二十世纪进入日常语言，成为任何突然进步的比喻。

items.en: The exact first written uses for the figurative and computing senses are approximate; the Latin source and the physics coinage are well dated.
items.cn: 比喻义与计算义的最早书面用例年代为约数；拉丁来源与物理学造词的年代都有明确记录。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same how-much root; group two holds amount words that overlap with quantum outside physics.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「多少」词根的词；第二组是物理学之外与 quantum 重叠的数量词。

entries.definition: From Latin quantitas, built on quantus: how much there is of something, measured without the idea of a smallest packet.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁语，构于「多少」之上：某物有多少，不含「最小一份」的意思。

entries.definition: From Latin quota pars 'how great a part': an allotted share, from the same family of quantity words.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁语「多大的一份」：分配到的份额，同属数量词族。

entries.definition: From Latin quorum 'of whom', the opening word of a commission's formula: the minimum number of members needed, not a quantum.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁语「其中之人的」，是委任套语的开头：指所需的最低人数，并非量子。

entries.definition: Of uncertain origin and no connection with quantus: a state of puzzled doubt.
entries.definitionCN: 来源不确定，与「多少」无关：指困惑两难的处境。

entries.definition: An ordinary word for a small wrapped portion; it conveys the 'arrives in portions' idea without the physics.
entries.definitionCN: 日常指一小包东西；能传达「按份到来」的意思，但不含物理含义。

entries.definition: A general word for one countable item or standard measure; quantum is a unit fixed by nature, not by convention.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指一个可数项或标准计量；量子是由自然固定而非由人约定的单位。

entries.definition: The modern name for a light quantum; every photon is a quantum, but not every quantum is a photon.
entries.definitionCN: 光量子的现代名称；每个光子都是量子，但并非每个量子都是光子。

entries.definition: A general word for how much of something exists, with no suggestion of discreteness.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指某物有多少，不含分立性的暗示。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Latin quantum 'how much': physics asks how much, and finds a smallest answer.
normal.cn: 拉丁语「多少」：物理学问「多少」，却找到一个最小的答案。

normal.en: The family runs quantum, quanta, quantize, quantization, quantal.
normal.cn: 同族词包括量子、量子（复数）、使量子化、量子化、分立的。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: quantum of energy, light quantum, quantum leap.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：能量子、光量子、量子跃迁。

normal.en: The same root appears in quantity and quota, both about measuring how much.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在数量与配额里，都与衡量多少有关。

normal.en: Outside physics the phrase quantum leap means a huge jump, even though a real quantum jump is the smallest possible one.
normal.cn: 物理学之外，「量子跃迁」指巨大跨越，而真正的量子跃迁恰恰是最小的一跳。

abstract.en: Picture a staircase whose steps are so small that they look like a slope from far away.
abstract.cn: 想象一级级极小的台阶，远看却像一道斜坡。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp that can only be switched to fixed brightness levels, never dimmed smoothly.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯只能调到固定的几档亮度，无法平滑变暗。

abstract.en: Picture a cash machine that pays only in whole coins, never in fractions.
abstract.cn: 想象取款机只付整枚硬币，从不付零头。

examples.en: Energy is absorbed in quanta, not in a smooth stream.
examples.cn: 能量按量子被吸收，而不是连续不断地流入。

examples.en: Each quantum of light carries a fixed amount of energy.
examples.cn: 每一份光量子都携带固定的能量。

examples.en: The discovery was a quantum leap for the whole field.
examples.cn: 这一发现对整个领域是巨大的一步。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「quant（量）+ um」——量到不能再分的那一格，就是量子

root: 拉丁 quantum「多少」，为 quantus「多大」的中性形式；同族含 quantity、quota。英语 quantum。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with the smallest packet of energy, pass through the light packet, the plural units and the attributive label, then to an electron's jump, its figurative reversal, quantum computing and finally a required share.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从最小的一份能量开始，经过光的一份、复数的单位与定语用法，再到电子的一跳、被反过来用的比喻、量子计算，最后是必需的份额。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a quantity that looks continuous from afar but arrives in indivisible steps when measured closely.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个远看连续的量，凑近测量时却按不可分的台阶到来。

branches.en: THE PACKET: energy and light are the same discovery seen twice, since light was the first quantity found in packets.
branches.cn: 小包：能量与光是同一发现的两面，因为光是最早被发现按包出现的量。

branches.en: THE COUNT: once things arrive in packets, theory counts packets and the plural becomes a working noun.
branches.cn: 计数：一旦事物按包到来，理论就清点包数，复数便成了常用名词。

branches.en: THE LABEL: the noun turns into a modifier and marks whole fields, from theory to computing.
branches.cn: 标签：名词转成定语，标记整个领域，从理论到计算。

branches.en: THE JUMP: discreteness forces an abrupt change, and everyday speech borrows it while reversing its size.
branches.cn: 跳跃：分立性迫使变化突然发生，日常语言借走它，却把大小反过来。

branches.en: THE SHARE: law and formal prose keep the original question and ask for a measurable minimum.
branches.cn: 份额：法律与正式文章保留原本的「多少」，要求一个可量的最低分量。

intro.en: Quantum is a Latin pronominal adjective turned noun, and its root family is small but busy in English.
intro.cn: quantum 是拉丁代词性形容词转成的名词，它的词根词族不大，却在英语里很活跃。

latinIntro.en: Latin quantus and quantum yield quantity, quantify, quantitative and quota in English; the ending -um marks the neuter form used as a noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 quantus 与 quantum 在英语里衍生出数量、量化、定量的与配额；-um 结尾标出用作名词的中性形式。

items.example: The adjective asks for a measure of size.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词问的是大小或分量。

items.example: The ending turns the adjective into an abstract noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个结尾把形容词变成抽象名词。

items.structure: quantum (neuter of quantus, used as a noun)
items.example: The court asked for a quantum of proof.
items.exampleCN: 法庭要求一定分量的证据。

items.example: The theory sums over many quanta.
Engineers quantize the signal before storing it.
items.exampleCN: 工程师在存储前先把信号量化。
量化去掉了平滑的连续体。
这个数量被测量了两次。

items.example: Each port received a fixed quota.
items.exampleCN: 每个港口分到固定的配额。
