definition_zh: 争吵；口角；抱怨；争吵的理由；[古] 方头箭
definition_en: an angry dispute between people, or to argue in an angry way
core_image: 两个人隔着一张小桌，声音越来越高，谁也不肯先闭嘴
scene: 两家人为了院子边上的一棵树吵了起来，声音惊动了整条街。The two families had quarrelled over a tree at the edge of the garden until the whole street heard.
sceneCN: 这里 quarrel 指争吵（第 1 个义项：口角冲突）；句意为两家人为了院子边上的一棵树吵了起来，声音惊动了整条街。

pos.zh: 争吵；口角；抱怨
争吵；抱怨；挑剔

senses.title: A family quarrel
senses.definition: an angry dispute between people, usually over something small
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间激烈的争执，起因往往很小
senses.example: The two families had quarrelled over a tree at the edge of the garden until the whole street heard.
senses.exampleCN: 两家人为了院子边上的一棵树争吵，声音惊动了整条街。
senses.why: The noun names the whole event: two sides, raised voices, a cause that looks small from outside.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词命名整个事件：两方、抬高的声音，以及在外人看来很小的起因。

senses.title: To quarrel
senses.definition: to argue angrily with someone, openly and without trying to hide it
senses.definitionCN: 公开而愤怒地与人争辩，并不试图掩饰
senses.example: They quarrelled in the street while the neighbours watched from their windows.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在街上争吵，邻居们都从窗户里看着。
senses.why: The verb shifts attention from the dispute to the act of conducting it.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词把注意力从争端本身移到进行争端的动作上。

senses.title: A quarrel with a plan
senses.definition: an objection or reason for disagreement, without any scene
senses.definitionCN: 一种反对或不同意的理由，并不伴随闹剧
senses.example: My only quarrel with the plan is the timetable.
senses.exampleCN: 我对这个计划唯一的意见是时间表。
senses.why: Here the word turns quiet: it names a disagreement with a thing or an idea rather than a fight with a person.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词安静下来：它指的是对某件事或某个想法的异议，而不是与人的争斗。

senses.title: A quarrel in the bow
senses.definition: a short square-headed bolt shot from a crossbow
senses.definitionCN: 十字弩射出的短方头箭
senses.example: The museum label reads: a quarrel, once used against armour.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆的标签写着：一支方头箭，曾用来对付盔甲。
senses.why: This is a separate borrowing, a weapon rather than a word spoken, and it survives mostly in archery history.
senses.whyCN: 这是另一个来源的借用，指一件武器而不是一句话，主要存活于射箭史里。

intro.en: Quarrel came into English from Old French querele, which goes back to Latin querela, 'a complaint'.
intro.cn: quarrel 经古法语 querele 进入英语，源头是拉丁语 querela（抱怨）。

items.en: Querela meant a complaint or a lament.
items.cn: querela 意为抱怨或哀诉。

items.en: French kept the legal sound of a formal complaint.
items.cn: 法语保留了正式控告的法律语气。

items.en: English first used quarrel for a complaint in court.
items.cn: 英语最初用 quarrel 指法庭上的控告。

items.en: The sense moved from a filed complaint to a loud dispute.
items.cn: 词义从提交的控告转向高声的争执。

items.en: A separate borrowing named the square-headed bolt.
items.cn: 另一个来源的借用命名了方头箭。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quar- family; the near-meaning group separates argument, dispute, squabble and feud.
note.cn: 形近组是 quar 词族；近义组把「论证」「争端」「拌嘴」「世仇」分开。

entries.definition: a place where stone is cut.
entries.definitionCN: 采石场。

entries.definition: a quarter of a gallon.
entries.definitionCN: 四分之一加仑。

entries.definition: a hard mineral of silica.
entries.definitionCN: 石英。

entries.definition: isolation to stop disease.
entries.definitionCN: 为阻断疾病而设的隔离。

entries.definition: a reasoned exchange of views.
entries.definitionCN: 有推理的观点交换。

entries.definition: a disagreement that may be formal.
entries.definitionCN: 可能是正式的分歧。

entries.definition: a petty noisy quarrel.
entries.definitionCN: 小题大做的吵闹。

entries.definition: a long bitter hostility between groups.
entries.definitionCN: 群体间长期的仇恨。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of two people at a small table, voices rising.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「两个人在小桌旁，声音越来越大」的画面。

normal.en: Quarrel hides querela, Latin for complaint: every fight starts as one.
normal.cn: quarrel 藏着 querela（拉丁语的抱怨）：每场争吵都从一句抱怨开始。

normal.en: Picture a tree at the edge of a garden and two families on either side.
normal.cn: 想象院子边上一棵树，两边各站一家人。

normal.en: Say KWOR-el; the word sounds blunt, like a door closing.
normal.cn: 读 KWOR-el，这个词听起来很钝，像一扇门关上。

normal.en: Double the l in the British spelling: quarrelled, quarrelling.
normal.cn: 英式拼写要双写 l：quarrelled、quarrelling。

normal.en: A quarrel is loud; a complaint can be silent. The word covers both.
normal.cn: quarrel 是响的，抱怨却可以是无声的；这个词两者都覆盖。

abstract.en: A quarrel is a complaint that has lost its patience.
abstract.cn: 争吵是失去了耐心的抱怨。

abstract.en: The word drifts from law to kitchen: the same form, a colder audience.
abstract.cn: 这个词从法庭漂到厨房：形式相同，听众更冷。

abstract.en: To quarrel with one's lot is to argue with a stone wall and still feel heard.
abstract.cn: 抱怨命运，就是跟一堵石墙争辩，却仍觉得自己被听见了。

examples.en: They quarrelled in the street while the neighbours watched from their windows.
examples.cn: 他们在街上争吵，邻居们都从窗户里看着。

examples.en: My only quarrel with the plan is the timetable.
examples.cn: 我对这个计划唯一的意见是时间表。

examples.en: He never quarrelled with his lot, though it gave him little.
examples.cn: 他从不抱怨自己的命运，尽管它给得很少。

dict_mnemonic.text: quar（抱怨）+ rel：一句抱怨没忍住，就变成一场争吵。

root: 拉丁语 querela（抱怨）→ 古法语 querele → 英语 quarrel

sensesIntro.en: The four senses run from the whole scene of a dispute, through the act of arguing and a quiet objection, to the old crossbow bolt that merely shares the spelling.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项从争执的整个场面，经过争吵的动作与安静的异议，最后到只是共用拼写的古老弩箭。

core.en: TWO VOICES RISING
core.cn: 两个越来越高的声音

branches.en: The whole scene of two sides falling out.
branches.cn: 两方失和的整个场面。

branches.en: The dispute and the act of conducting it.
branches.cn: 争端与进行争端的动作。

branches.en: A disagreement with a thing rather than a person.
branches.cn: 针对事情而非针对人的分歧。

branches.en: The old weapon that shares the spelling.
branches.cn: 共用这个拼写的古老武器。

branches.en: A loud fight and a quiet objection, one word.
branches.cn: 高声的争斗与安静的异议，同一个词。

intro.en: The quar- family is small in English but loud: quarrel, quarrelsome and quarreller all keep the sound of a complaint.
intro.cn: quar 词族在英语里不大，却很吵：quarrel、quarrelsome、quarreller 都保留着抱怨的声音。

latinIntro.en: Latin querela gives the noun, querelari the act of complaining; French trimmed the word to querele before English took it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 querela 提供名词，querelari 提供抱怨的动作；法语把它削成 querele，英语才接手。

items.meaning: in the middle of a dispute

items.exampleCN: 一个出了名爱吵架的人。

definition_zh: 石英；由二氧化硅结晶而成的常见矿物
definition_en: a hard mineral made of silicon dioxide, common in rocks, sand, and gem varieties
core_image: 河床白色卵石间一颗透明六棱晶体在阳光下闪光
scene: 河床的白色卵石里混着透明的小晶体，棱角在阳光下闪亮： A clear quartz crystal glittered among the river pebbles.
sceneCN: 这里 quartz 指「二氧化硅结晶成的矿物」（第 1 个义项：化学成分与晶体结构明确的矿物）；句意为一颗透明石英晶体在河卵石间闪光。

pos.zh: 石英（物质名词；指多种石英时复数为 quartzes）

senses.title: The mineral silicon dioxide
senses.definition: a hard, chemically simple mineral of silicon and oxygen, stable across a wide range of conditions
senses.definitionCN: 由硅与氧构成、化学组成简单、在很宽条件下稳定的坚硬矿物
senses.example: A clear quartz crystal glittered among the river pebbles.
senses.exampleCN: 一颗透明石英晶体在河卵石间闪光。
senses.why: Quartz is defined by its composition and lattice, not by colour or shape; those vary while the mineral stays the same.
senses.whyCN: 石英由成分与晶格定义，而非颜色或形状；后者会变，矿物本身不变。

senses.title: A crystal with six-sided prisms
senses.definition: a quartz crystal showing hexagonal prisms and pointed terminations
senses.definitionCN: 呈六棱柱与尖顶形态的石英晶体
senses.example: The quartz grew as a six-sided prism in the cavity.
senses.exampleCN: 石英在晶洞中长成六棱柱。
senses.why: Its lattice repeats in six-fold symmetry, so a freely grown crystal takes a hexagonal outline.
senses.whyCN: 其晶格以六重对称重复，因此自由生长的晶体呈六边形轮廓。

senses.title: The main component of sand
senses.definition: quartz grains that survive weathering and make up most sand and sandstone
senses.definitionCN: 经风化残留、构成大部分砂与砂岩的石英颗粒
senses.example: Most beach sand is quartz that rivers carried to the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 多数海滩砂是河流带到海边的石英。
senses.why: Quartz resists chemical weathering, so it outlasts other minerals and accumulates as sand.
senses.whyCN: 石英抗化学风化，因此比其它矿物存留更久，堆积成砂。

senses.title: A piezoelectric material
senses.definition: quartz used in watches, radios, and sensors because it generates charge when squeezed
senses.definitionCN: 因受压产生电荷而用于钟表、无线电与传感器的石英
senses.example: The quartz in the watch vibrates at a precise frequency.
senses.exampleCN: 手表中的石英以精确频率振动。
senses.why: Its regular lattice converts mechanical stress into electrical signal, which is why clocks can count it.
senses.whyCN: 其规整晶格把机械应力转为电信号，因此钟表可以「数」它。

senses.title: A gem and ornamental stone
senses.definition: clear or coloured quartz varieties valued as gems and carvings
senses.definitionCN: 作为宝石与雕刻材料而受珍视的透明或彩色石英变种
senses.example: Rose quartz is carved into small figures.
senses.exampleCN: 粉晶被雕成小摆件。
senses.why: Impurities add colour while the hard lattice takes a polish, turning a common mineral into a gem.
senses.whyCN: 杂质带来颜色，坚硬晶格又能抛光，于是常见矿物变成宝石。

senses.title: A vein in hydrothermal deposits
senses.definition: quartz filling cracks where hot mineral-rich water deposited silica
senses.definitionCN: 富含矿物的热水沉淀二氧化硅、充填裂缝形成的石英
senses.example: Gold often sits in quartz veins.
senses.exampleCN: 黄金常赋存于石英脉中。
senses.why: Hot fluids carry silica and metals together; when they cool, quartz seals the crack and traps the ore.
senses.whyCN: 热液同时携带硅与金属；冷却时石英封住裂缝并圈闭矿石。

senses.title: A dust hazard
senses.definition: fine quartz dust that damages lungs when inhaled over years
senses.definitionCN: 长期吸入会损伤肺部的细石英粉尘
senses.example: Cutting stone without water raises quartz dust.
senses.exampleCN: 无水切割石材会产生石英粉尘。
senses.why: Hardness makes the mineral useful, and the same hardness makes its dust cut lung tissue.
senses.whyCN: 硬度使矿物有用，同样的硬度又使粉尘割伤肺组织。

senses.title: An industrial raw material
senses.definition: quartz sand and crushed quartz used in glass, ceramics, and foundry moulds
senses.definitionCN: 用于玻璃、陶瓷与铸造砂型的石英砂与碎石英
senses.example: The glassworks buys pure quartz sand by the tonne.
senses.exampleCN: 玻璃厂成吨购买纯石英砂。
senses.why: Silica is the backbone of glass, so a cheap, pure source of quartz is an industrial necessity.
senses.whyCN: 二氧化硅是玻璃的骨架，因此廉价纯净的石英来源是工业必需品。

senses.title: Abstract: clear, hard, and unchanging
senses.definition: a quality of transparency combined with stubborn constancy
senses.definitionCN: 透明与固执恒常相结合的性质
senses.example: Her quartz clarity hid a very hard will.
senses.exampleCN: 她水晶般的清澈之下藏着极硬的意志。
senses.why: The metaphor joins two properties of the mineral: you can see through it, yet it yields to almost nothing.
senses.whyCN: 这一比喻结合矿物的两种属性：看得透，却几乎不为外物所动。

intro.en: Quartz entered English from German in the sixteenth century, probably from a Slavic word for hard. The deeper origin is uncertain. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: quartz 在 16 世纪从德语进入英语，可能来自斯拉夫语中表示「坚硬」的词。更深来源不确定。年代均为约数。

items.en: German miners called the mineral Quarz; Middle High German forms include twarc and quarc, showing that the word was still unsettled.
items.cn: 德国矿工把这种矿物称作 Quarz；中古高地德语形式包括 twarc 与 quarc，说明词形当时尚未固定。

items.en: The German word is generally thought to come from a Slavic adjective meaning 'hard', represented by Czech tvrdy and Polish twardy.
items.cn: 一般认为这个德语词来自斯拉夫语中意为「坚硬」的形容词，如捷克语 tvrdy 与波兰语 twardy。

items.en: Source uncertain: the Slavic adjective goes back to a reconstructed Proto-Slavic form, and its earlier Indo-European history is debated.
items.cn: 来源不确定：这个斯拉夫语形容词可上溯到一个重构的原始斯拉夫语形式，其更早的印欧语历史仍有争议。

items.en: English adopted quartz in the sixteenth century, when mineralogy was beginning to name substances systematically.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪借入 quartz，当时矿物学正开始系统地为物质命名。

items.en: Piezoelectric and optical uses developed in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, adding technical senses to the mineral name.
items.cn: 压电与光学用途在 19、20 世纪发展起来，为这一矿物名增添了技术含义。

note.en: Group one holds minerals and varieties that are chemically close to quartz; group two holds materials often confused with it.
note.cn: 第一组是化学上与石英接近的矿物与变种；第二组是常与石英混淆的材料。

entries.definition: A metamorphic rock made almost entirely of quartz grains; quartz is the mineral, quartzite the rock.
entries.definitionCN: 几乎全由石英颗粒构成的变质岩；石英是矿物，石英岩是岩石。

entries.definition: Meaning rich in quartz; it describes a rock's composition rather than naming the mineral.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「富含石英的」；它描述岩石成分，而非命名矿物。

entries.definition: Silicon dioxide as a substance, including its non-crystalline forms; quartz is its crystalline mineral form.
entries.definitionCN: 作为物质的二氧化硅，包括非晶形态；石英是它的结晶矿物形态。

entries.definition: Calcium carbonate, softer than quartz and reacting with acid; it is easily mistaken in the field.
entries.definitionCN: 碳酸钙，比石英软且遇酸反应；野外容易误认。

entries.definition: Purple quartz coloured by iron and radiation; it is quartz with a gem variety name.
entries.definitionCN: 由铁与辐射致色的紫色石英；它是带宝石变种名的石英。

entries.definition: Clear, colourless quartz; the old name distinguishes the gem form from ordinary grains.
entries.definitionCN: 透明无色的石英；这一旧名把宝石形态与普通颗粒区分开。

entries.definition: A hard, fine-grained silica rock; it is chemically like quartz but lacks visible crystals.
entries.definitionCN: 坚硬细粒的二氧化硅岩石；化学成分似石英，但无可见晶体。

entries.definition: Glass made by melting quartz; it keeps silica's properties without a crystal lattice.
entries.definitionCN: 熔融石英制成的玻璃；保留二氧化硅性质，但没有晶格。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real etymology notes, real mineral names and real collocations, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实词源注记、真实矿物名称与真实搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Quartz is silicon dioxide; hardness and acid resistance follow from that chemistry.
normal.cn: 石英是二氧化硅；硬度与耐酸性都由此化学性质而来。

normal.en: Six-sided prisms grow because the lattice repeats in six-fold symmetry.
normal.cn: 六棱柱源于晶格的六重对称重复。

normal.en: Most sand is quartz that outlasted everything else.
normal.cn: 多数砂是熬过其它矿物的石英。

normal.en: Quartz watches count the vibration of a quartz plate.
normal.cn: 石英表数的是石英片的振动。

normal.en: Quartz, quartzite, quartzose, silica, amethyst form one family.
normal.cn: quartz、quartzite、quartzose、silica、amethyst 构成一个词族。

abstract.en: Picture a window that is also a stone.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇同时是石头的窗。

abstract.en: Picture a tuning fork made of rock, humming at one exact pitch.
abstract.cn: 想象一把石头做的音叉，以某个精确音高嗡鸣。

abstract.en: Picture a person you can see through but cannot move.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人，你看得透，却推不动。

examples.en: A clear quartz crystal glittered among the river pebbles.
examples.cn: 一颗透明石英晶体在河卵石间闪光。

examples.en: Quartz resists weathering, so it survives as sand long after other minerals decay.
examples.cn: 石英抗风化，因此在其它矿物分解后仍以砂的形式存留。

examples.en: The vein of quartz carries tiny amounts of gold.
examples.cn: 这条石英脉含有微量黄金。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「夸兹」——透明、坚硬、能报时的石头 → 石英

root: 德语 Quarz，可能来自斯拉夫语表示「坚硬」的形容词（捷克语 tvrdy、波兰语 twardy），再上溯重构的原始斯拉夫语形式；更深印欧语来源有争议。化学成分二氧化硅。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses move from the mineral's composition to its crystal shape, its sand, its technical uses, its gem forms, its veins, its dust, its industry, and finally to clarity as a character image.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从矿物成分走到晶体形态、砂粒、技术用途、宝石形态、矿脉、粉尘、工业，最后落到作为性格意象的清澈。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a transparent six-sided crystal catching light among ordinary river pebbles.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗透明六棱晶体在普通河卵石之间反光。

branches.en: COMPOSITION AND FORM: the same silica lattice explains both the mineral's identity and its six-sided shape.
branches.cn: 成分与形态：同一二氧化硅晶格既解释矿物身份，也解释六棱外形。

branches.en: SURVIVOR: hardness and acid resistance let quartz outlast other minerals as sand.
branches.cn: 幸存者：硬度与耐酸性让石英以砂的形式熬过其它矿物。

branches.en: SIGNAL AND VEIN: the lattice converts stress into charge, and hot fluids deposit quartz in cracks.
branches.cn: 信号与矿脉：晶格把应力转为电荷，热液则在裂缝中沉淀石英。

branches.en: BEAUTY AND USE: impurities make gems, while cheap pure grains make glass and moulds.
branches.cn: 美与用：杂质造宝石，廉价纯净颗粒则造玻璃与砂型。

branches.en: HARDNESS TWO WAYS: dust cuts lungs, and the same unyielding clarity becomes a human metaphor.
branches.cn: 坚硬的两种方向：粉尘割肺，同样的不屈清澈又成为人的比喻。

intro.en: Quartz has a small but clear family of mineral and technical derivatives.
intro.cn: quartz 的词族不大，但矿物与技术派生词脉络清楚。

latinIntro.en: Quartz is not Latin in origin; the related technical vocabulary uses Latin silica and Greek krystallos.
latinIntro.cn: quartz 并非拉丁语来源；相关技术词汇使用拉丁语 silica 与希腊语 krystallos。

items.structure: German Quarz, from Middle High German twarc
items.example: German miners spread the name Quarz.
items.exampleCN: 德国矿工传播了 Quarz 这个名称。

items.example: Quartz is hard and resists acid.
The quartzose sandstone is very hard.
items.exampleCN: 这块石英质砂岩非常坚硬。
砂岩重结晶时形成石英岩。

items.example: A quartziferous vein cuts the limestone.
items.exampleCN: 一条含石英矿脉切穿石灰岩。

items.example: Silica is the chemical backbone of quartz.
items.exampleCN: 二氧化硅是石英的化学骨架。

items.example: Amethyst is quartz with iron colouring.
items.exampleCN: 紫水晶是含铁致色的石英。

items.structure: origin uncertain, perhaps from flint terminology
items.meaningCN: 隐晶质二氧化硅岩石；燧石类
items.example: Chert has the chemistry of quartz without visible crystals.
items.exampleCN: 燧石具石英的化学性质，却无可见晶体。

items.meaning: a solid with a regular lattice
items.meaningCN: 具规则晶格的固体；晶体
items.example: A quartz crystal has six-fold symmetry.

latinEntries.structure: Greek krystallos (ice, crystal), borrowed into Latin

definition_zh: 问卷；调查表；问题清单；（研究用的）问卷工具
definition_en: a printed or digital set of questions used to collect information from a group of people
core_image: 一叠同样的问题发给很多人，回来的纸上写满勾选
scene: 这里指「问卷」。 Only half of the patients returned the follow-up questionnaire on sleep quality.
sceneCN: 这里 questionnaire 是「问卷」（第 1 个义项：一组书面问题构成的调查表）；句意：只有一半病人交回了关于睡眠质量的随访问卷。图中可辨识物件：同一叠表格、勾选方框、回邮信封。

pos.zh: 问卷；调查表；问题清单

senses.title: A set of written questions
senses.definition: a printed or digital form containing a series of questions for many respondents
senses.definitionCN: 含一系列问题、供众多受访者使用的印刷或电子表格
senses.example: The clinic hands every new patient a short health questionnaire.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所给每位新病人一份简短的健康问卷。
senses.why: The defining feature is sameness: one set of questions is given to many people, so the answers can later be lined up side by side.
senses.whyCN: 决定性特征是相同：同一组问题给许多人，好让回答后来可以并排对齐。

senses.title: A research instrument
senses.definition: a standardised tool used by researchers to collect comparable answers across a sample
senses.definitionCN: 研究者用来在样本中收集可比回答的标准化工具
senses.example: The team validated the questionnaire before sending it to two thousand households.
senses.exampleCN: 团队在对两千户发放前先验证了这份问卷。
senses.why: Research turned the form into an instrument: the same wording is given to everyone so that answers can be counted and compared.
senses.whyCN: 研究把表格变成工具：同一套措辞给所有人，好让回答能被计数与比较。

senses.title: A clinical self-report
senses.definition: a standard set of questions on which a patient reports symptoms, mood or function
senses.definitionCN: 由病人自报症状、情绪或功能的一套标准问题
senses.example: The depression questionnaire asks about the past two weeks only.
senses.exampleCN: 这份抑郁自评问卷只询问过去两周的情况。
senses.why: Clinical use narrows the set to symptoms and a fixed time window, so that scores from different patients mean the same thing.
senses.whyCN: 临床用法把问题集合收窄到症状与固定时间窗，使不同病人的分数含义相同。

senses.title: A survey by post or link
senses.titleCN: 通过邮寄或链接进行的调查
senses.definition: the whole exercise of distributing forms and collecting completed answers
senses.definitionCN: 分发表格并收集已填回答的整个活动
senses.example: Response rates to the postal questionnaire were lower than expected.
senses.exampleCN: 邮寄问卷的回收率低于预期。
senses.why: The word can name the operation, not just the paper: a questionnaire is also the round of asking and collecting that the form makes possible.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也能指整个操作而非仅指纸张：问卷也是这张表所促成的询问与回收轮次。

senses.title: A hiring or admissions form
senses.titleCN: 招聘或入学的问题清单
senses.definition: a list of questions used by an employer or school to screen applicants
senses.definitionCN: 雇主或学校用来筛选申请者的问题清单
senses.example: The application questionnaire asked candidates to describe a difficult decision.
senses.exampleCN: 申请问卷要求候选人描述一次艰难的决定。
senses.why: Screening is a different purpose for the same instrument: identical questions let a hundred applicants be judged against one standard.
senses.whyCN: 筛选是同一工具的另一种用途：相同的问题让上百名申请者按同一标准被评判。

senses.title: An online form
senses.definition: a digital questionnaire delivered by web link or app, often with automatic scoring
senses.definitionCN: 通过网络链接或应用发放、常带自动计分的电子问卷
senses.example: The online questionnaire closed automatically after five hundred replies.
senses.exampleCN: 在线问卷在收到五百份回复后自动关闭。
senses.why: The delivery method changed, the instrument did not: the same questions travel by link and return already encoded as data.
senses.whyCN: 投递方式变了，工具没变：同样的问题通过链接发送，回来时已编码成数据。

senses.title: A structured interview schedule
senses.definition: a fixed list of questions read aloud in the same order to every interviewee
senses.definitionCN: 按同一顺序向每位受访者念出的固定问题清单
senses.example: Interviewers read the questionnaire aloud and recorded answers verbatim.
senses.exampleCN: 访谈员朗读问卷并逐字记录回答。
senses.why: Reading aloud keeps the wording identical from one respondent to the next, which is what makes the answers comparable at all.
senses.whyCN: 朗读使措辞在每位受访者之间保持完全一致，这正是回答得以比较的前提。

senses.title: A statistical data source
senses.definition: the instrument whose answers become variables in a statistical analysis
senses.definitionCN: 其回答将成为统计分析变量的工具
senses.example: Income data in the study came from a household questionnaire.
senses.exampleCN: 研究中的收入数据来自一份家庭问卷。
senses.why: Once answers are coded, the sheet becomes a column in a data set: that is how a paper instrument turns into statistical evidence.
senses.whyCN: 回答一经编码，表格就成为数据集中的一列：纸质工具正是这样变成统计证据。

intro.en: Questionnaire is a French word, built from question plus the suffix -aire, which comes from Latin -arius. Question itself goes back to Latin quaestio and quaerere, 'to seek or ask'. English borrowed the French form in the 19th century, when social surveys began to need a name for the printed list.
intro.cn: questionnaire 是法语词，由 question 加后缀 -aire 构成，后者来自拉丁 -arius。question 本身可回溯到拉丁 quaestio 与 quaerere“寻求、询问”。英语在 19 世纪借入法语形式，当时社会调查开始需要为印刷问题清单起名。

items.en: Quaerere meant 'to seek, to ask, to inquire'. It is the verb behind question, query, inquiry, require and acquire.
items.cn: quaerere 意为“寻求、询问、探究”，是 question、query、inquiry、require、acquire 背后的动词。

items.en: Quaestio named a seeking or an inquiry, and in legal use an investigation. French turned it into question.
items.cn: quaestio 命名寻求或探究，法律上指调查。法语把它变成 question。

items.en: French question kept both the asking and the doubting senses, and English borrowed it in the Middle Ages.
items.cn: 法语 question 同时保留“询问”与“质疑”两义，英语在中世纪借入。

items.en: The French suffix -aire, from Latin -arius, marks a person or thing connected with something, as in bibliothécaire or questionnaire.
items.cn: 法语后缀 -aire 来自拉丁 -arius，标记与某物相关的人或物，如 bibliothécaire 与 questionnaire。

items.en: French formed questionnaire in the 19th century for a set of questions used in an inquiry. English adopted the spelling unchanged.
items.cn: 法语在 19 世纪造出 questionnaire，指调查中使用的一组问题。英语原样采用了这个拼写。

items.en: Sample surveys, market research and clinical scales made the questionnaire a standard instrument with rules for design and validation.
items.cn: 抽样调查、市场研究与临床量表使问卷成为有设计与验证规范的标准工具。

note.en: The look-alike group separates questionnaire from question, questioner and the similar-looking but different-root quest. The meaning group compares surveys, polls and forms.
note.cn: 形近组区分 questionnaire 与 question、questioner，以及拼写相近但词根不同的 quest；词义组比较调查、民意测验与表格。

entries.definition: a single inquiry, or to ask. It is the base word, while questionnaire names a whole set.
entries.definitionCN: 单个问题，或询问。它是基础词，而 questionnaire 命名整套问题。

entries.definition: a person who asks questions. It names the asker, not the paper.
entries.definitionCN: 提出问题的人。它命名提问者，而不是纸张。

entries.definition: doubtful or open to suspicion. It shares the root but moves toward doubt rather than inquiry.
entries.definitionCN: 可疑的、有问题的。它共享词根，但转向怀疑而非询问。

entries.definition: a long search or journey. It comes from the same seeking verb but names a search, not a form.
entries.definitionCN: 漫长的寻找或旅程。它来自同一个“寻求”动词，却命名寻找，而非表格。

entries.definition: the whole research exercise of collecting data from a sample. The questionnaire is only its instrument.
entries.definitionCN: 从样本收集数据的整个研究活动。问卷只是它的工具。

entries.definition: a count of opinions, usually political. It is a short survey, often with one or two questions.
entries.definitionCN: 意见计数，通常指政治民调。它是简短调查，常只有一两个问题。

entries.definition: a document with blanks to complete. It collects facts, while a questionnaire collects answers to questions.
entries.definitionCN: 留有空白待填的文件。它收集事实，而问卷收集对问题的回答。

entries.definition: a standard list of items or symptoms to be checked. In clinical use it is close to a questionnaire.
entries.definitionCN: 供勾选的标准条目或症状清单。在临床用法中接近问卷。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the picture of one stack of identical questions, then let it cover research, clinics, post, hiring, online forms, interviews and statistics.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩保留“一叠完全相同的问题”的画面，再让它覆盖研究、诊所、邮寄、招聘、线上表格、访谈与统计。

normal.en: Split it as question + aire: question + French noun ending. It is a set of questions wearing a French coat.
normal.cn: 拆成 question + aire：问题、法语名词词尾。它是一组问题披着法语的衣裳。

normal.en: Picture one stack of identical sheets handed to a whole room.
normal.cn: 想象一叠完全相同的表格发给整个房间的人。

normal.en: The returned sheets are what makes it research: same questions, comparable answers.
normal.cn: 收回的表格才使它成为研究：同样的问题，可比的回答。

normal.en: Tear one sheet off the stack and you have a form; keep the stack and you have a survey.
normal.cn: 从一叠里撕下一张，你得到表格；保留整叠，你得到调查。

normal.en: In a clinic the stack asks about symptoms; in an office it asks about decisions.
normal.cn: 在诊所，这一叠问症状；在办公室，这一叠问决策。

abstract.en: Notice that the noun names the instrument, not the finding: the results belong to the survey, not to the paper.
abstract.cn: 注意这个名词命名工具，而非发现：结果属于调查，而不属于纸张。

abstract.en: Keep the -aire ending visible: it is a French borrowing, so the spelling has no English -er.
abstract.cn: 让 -aire 词尾保持可见：它是法语借词，因此拼写里没有英语的 -er。

abstract.en: Remember the pair: a questionnaire is answered by respondents, an interview schedule is read by an interviewer.
abstract.cn: 记住配对：问卷由受访者填写，访谈问题表由访谈员朗读。

examples.en: Every participant completed a questionnaire on diet and exercise.
examples.cn: 每位参与者都填写了一份饮食与运动问卷。

examples.en: The questionnaire was translated into three languages before the survey began.
examples.cn: 调查开始前，问卷被译成三种语言。

examples.en: Researchers piloted the questionnaire on forty students to catch unclear wording.
examples.cn: 研究者先在四十名学生中试用问卷，以发现含糊的措辞。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音“快身耐儿”：快把身上耐性勾一勾，一张问卷问到底。

root: 法语 questionnaire（19 世纪），由 question 加 -aire（源自拉丁 -arius）构成；question 出自拉丁 quaestio、quaerere“寻求、询问”。

sensesIntro.en: Every sense is a set of identical questions: printed for a clinic, standardised for research, self-reported in medicine, mailed or linked, used to screen applicants, read aloud in interviews, and coded into statistical variables. The paper changes form; the sameness of the questions does not.
sensesIntro.cn: 每个义项都是一组完全相同的问题：为诊所印制、为研究标准化、在医学中自评、通过邮寄或链接发放、用来筛选申请者、在访谈中朗读，并被编码成统计变量。纸张的形式在变，问题的同一性不变。

core.en: One set of questions is repeated for many people so that the answers can be compared.
core.cn: 同一组问题被重复给许多人，好让回答可以比较。

branches.en: INSTRUMENT: a standard set of questions serves research.
branches.cn: 工具：一套标准问题服务研究。

branches.en: DATA: clinical reports and coded answers become variables.
branches.cn: 数据：临床报告与被编码的回答变成变量。

branches.en: DELIVERY: post and web links carry the same sheets outward.
branches.cn: 发放：邮寄与网络链接把同样的表格送出去。

branches.en: SCREENING: employers and schools use the list to judge applicants.
branches.cn: 筛选：雇主与学校用这份清单判断申请者。

branches.en: INTERVIEW: an interviewer reads the fixed list aloud in order.
branches.cn: 访谈：访谈员按顺序朗读固定清单。

intro.en: Questionnaire is question plus the French suffix -aire. The items below follow the asking verb through its person, adjective and the seeking relatives.
intro.cn: questionnaire 由 question 与法语后缀 -aire 构成。下列条目沿着“询问”动词，走过人称、形容词以及“寻求”亲属词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries give the seeking verb and the inquiry noun. They explain why question, query, require and acquire all belong to one family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语条目给出“寻求”动词与“探究”名词，解释为什么 question、query、require 与 acquire 同属一个词族。

items.meaning: a set of questions for many respondents
items.exampleCN: 这份问卷有二十个题目。

items.meaning: an inquiry; to ask or doubt
items.exampleCN: 有一个问题仍未得到回答。

items.example: The questioner raised her hand again.

items.meaning: the act of asking; showing doubt

items.example: She sent a query about the invoice.

items.meaning: to seek again, hence to demand
to seek toward oneself, hence to obtain
items.example: The museum acquired the painting in 1960.
items.exampleCN: 博物馆于 1960 年获得这幅画。
